additional_info.subject: URGENT – Level 3 Support Request – Sicharge D MPR8170002536 – TER Transports Courthézon
additional_info.body:
Dear all,
We are facing a critical malfunction on Sicharge D charger MPR8170002536, installed at the TER Transports site in Courthézon.
Please open a Level 3 support ticket and include the relevant Siemens France and Siemens Germany teams in copy.
Issue observed – June 3rd, 2025, between 08:15 and 08:30:
A etruck was connected to CCS2 (right connector), but the charger displayed “Out of Service”.
At the same time, CCS2 (left connector) showed “Charging complete – 100%” while no eTruck was connected.
A first reboot made both connectors unavailable.
A second reboot was necessary to restore full functionality.
Supervision interface (e-Autonomh) showed connector 2 stuck in “Preparing” status since 08:26:23, despite active communication.
Attached screenshots:
Chrome crash error (Error code: 5)
False 100% charge displayed on CCS2 (right)
Supervision status showing connector 2 (
right)
stuck in “Preparing”
Additional context:
Other chargers on site show similar unstable behavior: ignored commands, interrupted sessions, memory saturation.
A firmware issue may be involved.
Preventive maintenance (filter replacement) is ongoing, managed by Siemens.
No feedback has been received yet from Siemens France regarding our warranty extension request.
We request:
Immediate escalation to Level 3
Root cause analysis
Firmware and software version check
Clear corrective actions to prevent recurrence
Thank you for your urgent support.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob:
+33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|
+33 970 755 400
Design and installation of EV charging equipment and infrastructure
.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0428974-DC/SI-D/FR [MP / R8 170002536] Outlets Out of Service CRM:00251000552
additional_info.body:
Bonjour Malek,
J’ai pris en charge le ticket et je constate que le problème provient du fusible de commande du ventilateur principal. Nous allons envoyer un technicien sur site pour le remplacer dès que possible.
Concernant les problèmes logiciels, je peux te proposer une mise à jour vers la version supérieure (V6.1 au lieu de V6.0).Les arrêts de session peuvent être dus à une température excessive (dérating pendant la charge, suivi d’un arrêt automatique).
Antoine, peux-tu me donner les rapports de maintenance si vous les avez et si non, me donnéer les dates. Le problème vient peut etre aussi des filtres non changés et des arrivés de cables non fermés.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen/ Best regards,Francois WINCKEL

additional_info.subject: Global ISP Backlog Cleanup initiative - Help Us Update Your ISP Ticket Status CRM:00362000093
additional_info.body:
Dear Ramdane,
I hope this email finds you well!
As part of our Customer Service team's global initiative to clean up our ticketing backlog, we're reaching out to help streamline our open cases.
During a recent review of our ISP ticketing system, we noticed several aging tickets that need a quick status check. We're here to help make this process as smooth as possible for you.
Would you be able to help us confirm:
If the repair/resolution has been completed
Whether any follow-up actions are still pending
Any relevant comments about the current situation
Don't worry about the administrative part - our central Customer Service team will take care of closing the tickets once you confirm their status.
If you could add any brief comments that might be helpful for documentation and provide your confirmation by replying to this email, that would be great!
Thanks so much for your help with this initiative! If you need any assistance or have questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.
